name: Almost Heaven Pinnacle 4-Person Barrel Sauna, 6x6 ft.
description: Almost Heaven Pinnacle 4-Person Barrel Sauna, 6x6 ft. Tried and true, the Pinnacle barrel sauna is both a staple and a best-seller. Measuring 6'x 6', this barrel sauna embodies “happy medium” to a T: not too small and not too big. You can stretch out on your own or invite three friends to experience the magic of a sauna. Paired with a 6 kW electric heater, you’ll be sweating in less than 45 minutes as the temperatures climb to 190ºF and beyond. Prefer a sauna first thing in the morning? Turn the dial (or your WiFi controls!) and delay the start time up to eight hours while you sleep. Instant relaxation is right around the corner with the Almost Heaven Pinnacle 4-Person Barrel Sauna! Features Ball-and-socket lumber: 1-3/8″ thick Any glass features are tempered Stainless steel bands, hinges, and fasteners Interior LED light Sauna stones included Weather-resistant plastic support cradles Two opposite-facing benches for sitting or reclining Indoor or outdoor usage Hand-crafted lumber profiles and end sections Limited lifetime warranty on the sauna room; 5-year limited lifetime warranty on the heater and its components, with a 1-year warranty on the heating elements (coils) Best-in-class electric heater & sauna stones Made in the USA Specifications Holds up to four people Heater size: 6 kW, 240V, 30-amp requirement, hardwire connect Lighting electrical: 110V, 15-amp service, plug-in connect Assembled size: 72″W x 72″D x 77″H Interior dimensions: 71″W x 64″D x 71″H Bench dimensions: 18″W x 64″L x 17″H Cradle dimensions 54" x 6 Shipping weight: 715 lbs Shipping size: 74″L x 41″W x 48″H Note: All dimensions are approximate Options and Customizations Vista or Port rear window: Open the Pinnacle barrel sauna interior to breathtaking views with the addition of the Vista or Port rear window. Door style: Outfit your Pinnacle 4-Person Barrel Sauna with one of the following deluxe door options: full glass door, wood door with a window, or all-wood door. Heater: You can upgrade the Pinnacle barrel sauna from the standard Harvia KIP60B heater to a number of options. Scroll up to see all of them! Care and Maintenance Traditional barrel saunas require very little upkeep. Simply wipe down the interior after each use and check for any dust or debris that you may have tracked in. Shipping and Assembly The Pinnacle sauna will ship via an LTL truck and will arrive curbside on a single pallet. See the shipping tab for more details. Some basic handyman skills are helpful when assembling the sauna. The only additional equipment needed is a cordless drill. Two people can generally do the assembly in 6 hours or less. It is recommended that you review the manual’s assembly instructions in advance to familiarize yourself with the process. Two Ways to Enjoy Your Sauna Heater and stones are essential to a traditional sauna experience. With the room at least heated to 160ºF, the traditional sauna can be enjoyed in two ways. The first is called a dry sauna, which lacks any added moisture. The second is called a wet sauna, where you sprinkle water onto the heated stones to create a refreshing burst of steam and added humidity. Why Select Saunas? When it comes to customizing your sauna, we're the premier source for Almost Heaven Saunas. At Select Saunas, choose not only from our deluxe door and window options but also any heater or customization of your choice, and we'll accommodate you! Every sauna is backed by the original manufacturer's warranty, ensuring the highest standards of quality and performance. Plus, enjoy the benefits of free shipping, hassle-free returns, a no-questions-asked satisfaction guarantee, and complimentary gifts with your order!
